name: jobicy-deals-mcp
description: Jobicy (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: Keyless ('No API key … No account or authentication header is required'). location must be a Jobicy location slug (?get=locations lists them); there is no page parameter — count is the whole result set, so page > 1 repeats it. Jobicy asks that stored listings be re-checked only 'once or twice per hour'. An official MCP server also exists at https://jobicy.com/mcp. Mirrors jobs/jobicy: category is sent as industry (documented filters: count, geo, industry, tag). buyer is the hiring company; salaryMin/Max map to budget_min/max.
